KONGZI_MUDUO.title: Muduo
KONGZI_MUDUO.description: Zhou Li: If you play a Skill or Power before an Attack each turn, your first Skill grants 2 temporary Strength and later Skills grant 1, up to 5. If you Attack first, lose 1 Strength this turn and Skills grant no Strength.
KONGZI_MUDUO.flavor: A wooden-tongued bell used to carry an ordered proclamation.
KONGZI_QING_YU_PEI.title: Green Jade Pendant
KONGZI_QING_YU_PEI.description: When all living enemies have non-Attack intents, if you could play an Attack this turn but play none, practice Ren: permanently gain 1 Virtue and append 1 distinct Uncommon or Rare card to this combat's normal card reward. You may still choose only 1 card. Playing an Attack before Ren succeeds forfeits it for this combat; once resolved, the result cannot change.
KONGZI_QING_YU_PEI.flavor: The noble compare virtue to jade: gentle, lustrous, and enduring.
MENGZI_XIONG_ZHANG.title: Bear Paw
MENGZI_XIONG_ZHANG.description: For the first N turns of each combat, gain 1 Energy and draw 2 additional cards. N equals your Virtue.
MENGZI_XIONG_ZHANG.flavor: I desire fish, and I also desire bear's paw.
XUNZI_SHENG_MO.title: Ink Line
XUNZI_SHENG_MO.description: The first time each turn you consecutively play a Skill, an Attack, and a Skill, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
XUNZI_SHENG_MO.flavor: Wood becomes straight by the ink line; metal becomes sharp on the whetstone.
